notes.title: 2025-09-23 Update Notes
notes.notes:
New Features:

1. Unblock Microphone

2. Block Feature (Access the Block button in the bottom-right corner of the Match History page. Blocking a player reduces your matchmaking probability with them)



Optimized:

1. Added AK47 and shotgun gold series skins with flash effects

2. Reduced M-Coin item prices and extended time limits

3. Adjusted point-to-M-Coin exchange rate to 1:1

4. Updated certain English translations

5. Removed minor map objects that blocked vehicles

6. Warehouse now displays specific expiration dates

7. Adjusted vehicle collision direction (reduced chain collision mechanics)

8. Increased vehicle damage against AI



Bug Fixes:

1. Fixed incorrect shadow projection for certain buildings

2. Resolved building misalignment and road elevation issues

3. Disabled display of scrapped vehicles at excessive distances

notes.title: 2025-09-11 Update Notes
notes.notes:
New Features:
1. Microphone disabled in Solo mode, re-enabled after match completion
2. Scrapyard skin update
3. M-Coin skin update
4. M-Coin acquisition mechanism: Earned through matches played between 12:00 PM–2:00 PM and 7:00 PM–12:00 AM (Beijing Time). Calculation formula:
Ranking Value + AI Kill Value + Player Kill Value
Rank Value = 120 - (Rank * 20) (capped at 20 when rank is between 5 and 10)
Bot Kill Value = Number of Bots * 1, Player Kill Value = Number of Players * 2
MB can be exchanged using Points
5. Optimized shotgun reticle settings (multiple styles available)

Optimizations:
1. Players on vehicles no longer hit (feature updated earlier)
2. First-person view occasionally misses enemies
3. Name change card price adjusted to 3000 Points

Bug Fixes:
1. No sound when hit while on a vehicle
2. Jeep prone to flying into the air

Update Bonus CDK: FMTC0911VFKKLL
